title: 第32章 张国海怒打巴儿姐
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “他爸，完了。巴儿姐可能怀了，怎么办？”即使范金花再看不上张国海，可这时候，出了这种事唯一可商量的人，就只有他。张国海一听，明显愣了好久。“意思赵丁的？”范金花心里也没把握，但目前来看，也只能这样认定。“除了他，还能有谁？”“那不行啊！赵丁都给抓起来了，谁来为这事负责？”张国海脑子里想的第一件事，就是让赵丁娶了巴儿姐。“不行！赵丁不在，他儿子还在！得让他们赵家对巴儿姐负责！”他自顾说着，就要出门去找赵小义。可是还没出门，又退回来，“不对，赵小义还欠我们钱没给！还断着腿，这个时候要是把巴儿姐往他家送，不是白便宜了他？”“你疯了吧？”范金花不敢置信地看着眼前的老头。她竟还指望这样的人？“赵家那对父子是畜生，你竟想着把姑娘往那家里送？”“不然怎么办？让她生出来，我们给姓赵的养孩子？等他劳改回来，再把孩子认回去？”张国海觉得范金花目光太短浅，要真是赵丁的种，不仅啥也捞不着，还倒贴给人白白养娃。“我说她怎么最近恁能吃，原来是揣了孽种！”张国海闷闷看着毫不知情的巴儿姐，“肚子都这么大了！”这事要是传出去，他张国海在清溪村就真成了掉进粪坑的死狗，头脸都没了。徐喜弟去灶边默默递柴火，没吭声。她才十八岁，处理这种事，没一点经验。全村，都没出过这样的事。就看老两口怎么商量解决。张国海忽然抬起头，那张满是褶子的脸忽然变得狰狞，“反正我是不可能替赵家养这个孽种的！”说着，他腾地站起来，因为起得太猛，身子晃了晃。他指着火房的方向，巴儿姐已经正坐在小板凳上，又开始烤糍粑。刘宇宁送来的一篮糯米糍粑，全都喂她肚子里去了。一边烤糍粑，还一边拿菜叶子逗小鸡仔。那副没心没肺的样子，看得张国海心头的火蹭蹭往上窜。“老子一辈子老老实实，临老了让这哑巴把脸都给丢尽了！”张国海的声音高了起来，带着一股子狠劲。范金花似乎感觉到了不对，连忙上去挡住他，一边问道，“你想干嘛？”“你撒走开！”张国海用力一甩，把范金花带了个踉跄。“都是你生的好女儿！当初我就说这哑巴是个讨债鬼，你非要养，非要养！现在好了，养出个祸胎来！”“张国海，你还有没有良心？她是你亲闺女！”范金花拍着腿大喊，“把她生成这样，就只怪我一个人吗？出了事，也全怪我？”“不怪你怪谁？”张国海四下瞅了瞅，瞧见墙根底下的顶门棍。他想也不想，几步跨过去，一把抓起木棍，眼珠子瞪得溜圆，“老子今天非打死这个不知廉耻的东西，省得她留在世上现眼！”徐喜弟吓了一跳，连忙冲上去拦，“爸！你这是做什么！有话好好说！”“滚开！还有你的账等下再算！”张国海这时候已经疯了心，像头疯牛，谁也拦不住他。巴儿姐听到动静，抬起头，看到拎着棍子冲过来的张国海，眼里露出一丝惊恐。她甚至不知道为什么，老爹突然就抄起棍子冲过来要打她。“阿巴……阿巴！”巴儿姐站起身就往后院跑。“还敢跑？你个贱货，老子今天非打折你的腿！”张国海拎着棍子在后面追，因为腿脚不利索，跑起来一深一浅的。范金花在后面跟着跑，嘴里喊着，“张国海你住手！你打死她你也得偿命！”徐喜弟也急了，张国海要是真下了死手，巴儿姐现在这个身子，可受不住。但巴儿姐跑得很快，她平常没事就在村里乱窜，身手比张国海灵活得多。可小小的后院菜园子，施展不开，没跑多久就被张国海堵在了水沟边上。水沟里都是湿滑的青苔。“跑啊！你再跑一个给老子看看！”张国海喘着粗气，举起木棍就往巴儿姐肩膀上劈。巴儿姐尖叫一声，侧身躲过。木棍砸在旁边的菜地里，发出梆的一声响，菜叶子乱飞。“阿巴！阿巴！”巴儿姐急了，那双原本清澈的眼里透出一股野性。她虽然傻，但力气极大。张国海见一棍子没打着，更气了，抡起棍子又是一下。这一下扫到了巴儿姐的胳膊，疼得她眼泪当场就下来了。“老子让你怀！让你不知廉耻！”张国海骂着，棍子不停地挥舞。巴儿姐被逼到了死角，后面就是水沟。她看着再次劈下来的棍子，突然整个人猛地往前一撞，两只手死死抓住了张国海的腰，然后用力往后一掀。张国海之前就吃过巴儿姐的亏，这次也没例外。他只觉得一阵天旋地转，整个人被甩到一边。噗通！一声巨响，张国海结结实实地摔进了水沟里。水溅了他一脸，连嘴里都灌进去不少青苔。“咳……咳咳！”张国海在水沟里挣扎着，那棍子掉在一边。他想爬起来，可水沟底下的青苔太滑，他越使劲越往下滑，模样十分狼狈。巴儿姐站在岸边，一边揉着被打疼的胳膊，一边对着水沟里狠狠地瞪了好几眼。忽然她又转过头，看见追过来的范金花和徐喜弟，眼神里全是戒备。“你……”范金花已经傻了，“你怎么把你爸给……”“阿巴巴，巴巴……”巴儿姐骂骂咧咧地反冲过来，推开范金花和徐喜弟，然后蹿了出去。“这丫头，跑哪儿去！”范金花急得直跺脚，想去追，又看看水沟里挣扎的丈夫。“妈，我去追巴儿姐！你先把爸拉上来！”徐喜弟喊了一声，追着巴儿姐出去了。清溪村的早晨已经热闹起来，各家各户都开了门。徐喜弟刚跑出院门，就瞧见巴儿姐的身影正往村后的林子里钻。“你别跑啊！”徐喜弟扯着嗓子喊，可巴儿姐根本不回头。“你别跑了！我又不打你！”没追多远，她就累得够呛。好追好赶，跑了几里地，巴儿姐的身影忽然慢了下来。到底是怀了身孕的人，这么没命地跑，不出事才怪。
content_en: "His father, it's over. Sister Ba'er may be pregnant, what should I do?" Even if Fan Jinhua no longer despises Zhang Guohai, at this time, he is the only person who can be discussed when such a thing happens.When Zhang Guohai heard this, he was obviously stunned for a long time."You mean Zhao Ding?" Fan Jinhua was not sure, but at present, she could only think so."Who else could be there besides him?" "That won't work! Zhao Ding has been arrested, who will be responsible for this?" The first thing that came to Zhang Guohai's mind was to let Zhao Ding marry Sister Ba'er."No! Zhao Ding is not here, but his son is still here! We have to make the Zhao family responsible for Sister Ba'er!" He said to himself, and was about to go out to find Zhao Xiaoyi.But before he went out, he came back and said, "No, Zhao Xiaoyi still owes us money and has not paid! He still has a broken leg. If he sends Sister Ba'er to his house at this time, won't he be given an advantage in vain?" "Are you crazy?" Fan Jinhua looked at the old man in front of her in disbelief.How could she expect such a person?"The father and son of the Zhao family are beasts. You actually want to send the girl to that family?" "What else should we do? Let her give birth, and we will raise a child for Zhao? Wait until he returns from the labor camp and then take the child back?" Zhang Guohai felt that Fan Jinhua was too short-sighted. If Zhao Ding was really the son of Zhao Ding, not only would he not be able to get anything, but he would also pay others to raise the child in vain."I asked her why she has been eating so hard recently. It turns out she is pregnant!" Zhang Guohai looked at the unsuspecting Sister Ba'er with a dull look, "She's already so big!" If this news got out, Zhang Guohai would really become a dead dog that fell into a manure pit in Qingxi Village, and his head and face would be lost.Xu Xidi went to the stove and handed over firewood silently without saying a word.She is only eighteen years old and has no experience in dealing with this kind of thing.Nothing like this has ever happened in the whole village.It depends on how the old couple negotiates and resolves the matter.Zhang Guohai suddenly raised his head, and his wrinkled face suddenly became ferocious, "Anyway, there is no way I can support this evil breed for the Zhao family!" As he said that, he stood up, and his body swayed because he stood up so violently.He pointed in the direction of the fire room. Sister Ba'er was already sitting on the small bench and started baking glutinous rice cakes again.The basket of glutinous rice cakes sent by Liu Yuning was all fed to her.While baking glutinous rice cakes, I also entertained the little chickens with vegetable leaves.That heartless look made Zhang Guohai feel angry."I have been honest all my life. When I get old, I will let this mute lose all his face!" Zhang Guohai's voice became louder and filled with fierceness.Fan Jinhua seemed to sense something was wrong, and quickly went up to block him, while asking, "What do you want to do?" "Go away!" Zhang Guohai swung Fan Jinhua hard, causing Fan Jinhua to stagger."They are all good daughters you gave birth to! I told you at the beginning that this mute was a debt collector, and you had to raise her, you had to raise her! Now it's fine, she's a troublemaker!" "Zhang Guohai, do you still have a conscience? She is your biological daughter."!"Fan Jinhua shouted, slapping her legs, "Is it only my fault that something happened?""Who do you blame?"Zhang Guohai looked around and saw the door stick under the wall.Without thinking, he stepped over, grabbed the wooden stick, and his eyes widened, "I must kill this shameless thing today, so that she won't show up in the world!" Xu Xidi was startled, and rushed to stop her, "Dad! What are you doing! Tell me what you have to say!" "Get away! We'll settle your debt later!" Zhang Guohai was already crazy at this time, like a mad cow, and no one could stop him.When Sister Ba'er heard the noise, she raised her head and saw Zhang Guohai rushing over with a stick, with a hint of panic in her eyes.She didn't even know why, but her father suddenly picked up a stick and rushed over to beat her."Aba...Aba!" Sister Ba'er stood up and ran to the backyard."You still dare to run? You bitch, I have to break your legs today!" Zhang Guohai chased after him with a stick. Because his legs and feet were not strong enough, he ran slowly and slowly.Fan Jinhua ran after her, shouting, "Zhang Guohai, stop! If you beat her to death, you will have to die!" Xu Xidi was also anxious. If Zhang Guohai really killed her, Sister Ba'er wouldn't be able to bear it in her current state.But Sister Ba'er runs very fast. She usually runs around the village when she has nothing to do. She is much more agile than Zhang Guohai.But the small backyard vegetable garden couldn't be used, and Zhang Guohai was blocked by the ditch after a short run.The ditches were filled with slippery moss."Run! Run another one to show me!" Zhang Guohai gasped, raised the wooden stick and struck Sister Ba'er on the shoulder.Sister Ba'er screamed and dodged sideways.The wooden stick hit the vegetable patch next to it, making a banging sound, and the vegetable leaves flew everywhere."Abba! Abba!" Sister Ba'er was anxious, with a wild look in her originally clear eyes.Although she is stupid, she is very powerful.Zhang Guohai became even more angry when he saw that the stick failed to hit him. He picked up the stick and hit him again.This time it swept Sister Ba'er's arm, causing her to burst into tears on the spot."I let you get pregnant! I made you shameless!" Zhang Guohai cursed and kept waving the stick.Sister Ba'er was forced into a blind corner, with a ditch behind her.She looked at the stick that had been chopped down again, and suddenly she slammed forward, grabbed Zhang Guohai's waist with both hands, and then pushed it back hard.Zhang Guohai has suffered from Sister Ba'er before, and this time is no exception.He just felt like the world was spinning, and his whole body was thrown aside.Plop!With a loud noise, Zhang Guohai fell solidly into the ditch.Water splashed all over his face, and a lot of moss got into his mouth."Cough...cough!" Zhang Guohai struggled in the ditch, and the stick fell aside.He wanted to get up, but the moss at the bottom of the ditch was too slippery. The harder he tried, the harder he slid down, looking very embarrassed.Sister Ba'er stood on the shore, rubbing her sore arm while glaring fiercely into the ditch several times.Suddenly she turned her head again and saw Fan Jinhua and Xu Xidi chasing after them, their eyes full of wariness."You..." Fan Jinhua was already dumbfounded, "Why did you give your dad to..." "Ababa, Baba..." Sister Ba'er cursed and rushed over, pushed Fan Jinhua and Xu Xidi away, and then jumped out."Where are you going, girl!" Fan Jinhua stamped her feet anxiously and wanted to chase her, then looked at her husband struggling in the ditch."Mom, I'm going to chase Sister Ba'er! Pull dad up first!" Xu Xidi shouted and chased Sister Ba'er out.The morning in Qingxi Village has become lively, and every household has opened its doors.As soon as Xu Xidi ran out of the courtyard, he saw Sister Ba'er's figure heading into the woods behind the village."Don't run away!" Xu Xidi shouted at the top of his lungs, but Sister Ba'er didn't even look back."Don't run away! I won't hit you!" She was exhausted after not chasing him very far.It was easy to chase and catch up. After running for several miles, Sister Ba'er's figure suddenly slowed down.After all, she was pregnant. It would be strange if nothing happened to her running away like this.
